title: Finite collar boundary-twist theorem and conditional endpoint-covariant N=1 interface witness
registration_reason: The Phase 7 and Phase 11 collar outputs, and the specific canonical-removability observation, were inspected before this contract. The initial acceptance and mutation matrix was frozen before the Phase 12 executable was written. Post-run adversarial review then narrowed source, adjoint, fermion-operator, and SUGRA wording without changing the algebraic pass/fail gates; no confirmation label is available.

claims.hypothesis: For S = integral[p.qdot - N C - a(u) J] du on a finite exact canonical chart, an autonomous complete generator with {C,J}=0 is removable from the open-interval bulk by the time-dependent Hamiltonian flow of J; only the transported endpoint data, endpoint symplectic twist, and a boundary generating function remain.
assumptions: a(u) is a prescribed real integrable profile rather than a dynamical defect field
the Hamiltonian flow of J is complete and invertible over the required finite parameter interval
there is no additional J-noninvariant bulk term
endpoint functionals, observables, and polarization are transported with the canonical transformation
canonical bulk equivalence is not identified automatically with gauge equivalence
acceptance: derive the transformation of the canonical one-form, not only the equations of motion
verify exact removal for the Phase 7 rotation, a Phase 11 momentum shear, and a representative boost
verify that, for one fixed autonomous generator, the endpoint holonomy depends only on kappa = integral a du while the interior frame follows the cumulative profile
verify that a generator which fails both {C,J}=0 and the allowed projective condition {C,J}=lambda C does not remain equivalent to the unchanged baseline bulk constraint
claims.novelty_note: This is a programme-local application of a standard Hamiltonian-flow lemma, not a literature-priority claim.

claims.hypothesis: Provided N is an unrestricted multiplier varied before any lapse parity/profile gauge fixing, the weak generator J_dil=q.p with {C,J_dil}=-2C is removable from the bulk together with the lapse redefinition N_new=N exp(-2 theta), leaving an endpoint dilation.
acceptance: verify the canonical one-form identity exactly
verify C(exp(-theta)P)=exp(-2theta)C(P) exactly
verify that omitting the lapse rescaling is a failing semantic mutant
claims.novelty_note: This is the weak/projective version of the same standard Hamiltonian-flow lemma.

claims.hypothesis: A nondegenerate 4D rigid N=1 Wess-Zumino parent can contain a BPS wall multiplet Phi and a spectator flavor doublet Z with a holomorphic rotating mass matrix. In its selected quadratic reduction, scalar and Weyl-fermion flavor indices inherit the same kinematic frame connection, while the scalar differential expressions factorize into the standard first-order forms associated with the chiralino mass matrix. Given conditional external oriented endpoint data, a reduced open frame-transport contraction is basis-invariant.
claims.parent_template: K=Phi_bar Phi+Z_bar Z and W=lambda(v^2 Phi-Phi^3/3)+Z^T M(Phi) Z/2, with real nonzero distinct m1,m2, M(Phi)=R(Theta(Phi)) diag(m1,m2) R(Theta(Phi))^T, and Theta(Phi)=kappa(Phi+v)/(2v). Formal bulk chiral generating spurions Delta W_src=j_minus h_minus(Phi)n_minus^T Z+j_plus h_plus(Phi)n_plus^T Z, h_plus/minus=(1 plus/minus Phi/v)/2, have complementary asymptotic values and are turned off after source differentiation; they are not a localized physical endpoint action.
acceptance: verify Phi=v tanh(lambda v z), Z=0 solves the selected rigid half-BPS wall equation and reaches F-flat endpoints
verify R^T R=I, det R=1, and symmetry of M(Phi) symbolically; distinguish holomorphic SO(2,C) from orthogonal SO(2) transport on the selected real wall slice
derive the common anti-Hermitian flavor-frame connection for bosonic canonical variables and the flavor index of the Weyl fermion

verify the rigid scalar differential expressions factorize as H_plus=D D_formal and H_minus=D_formal D for D=partial_z+M and formal differential adjoint D_formal=-partial_z+M, and obey the exact intertwining identities
verify M_plus=U M_minus U^T and the finite selected endpoint flavor identity S(M_plus) diag(U,U)=U S(M_minus), S(M)=[iM,I]
verify that a boson-only or unequal-angle mutation breaks the selected endpoint flavor identity
verify endpoint-basis covariance U -> g_plus U g_minus^{-1} and invariance of a reduced contraction n_plus^T U n_minus conditional on external oriented endpoint data
verify that the formal bulk chiral source profiles take complementary asymptotic endpoint values and vanish from the background when their source coefficients are set to zero
verify that unanchored open transport is removable by independent endpoint basis choices
claims.inference_scope: Conditional classical existence of an engineered rigid-N=1 internal-flavor wall and its selected quadratic covariance only. The contraction given external oriented endpoint data is a reduced frame-transport scalar, not a full Green function, S-matrix element, conversion probability, or a constructed physical endpoint observable. The executable does not derive the full 4D Weyl operator or its self-adjoint domain. This is not a local-SUGRA closure theorem, protected zero-mode bundle, temporal seam, gravity-anisotropy transfer, or evidence that nature realizes Temporal-Folded SUSY.
claims.novelty_note: The model is a post-hoc engineered Wess-Zumino witness with selected kappa, not a unique prediction or literature-priority claim.

claims.hypothesis: The rigid wall witness admits a specified regular matter-coupled 4D N=1 SUGRA classical uplift with the same physical spectator flavor eigenframe transport.
acceptance: derive or import a specified matter-coupled local-SUGRA action, including its off-shell formulation or compensator data where required, rather than append component terms by hand
verify the warped wall and all bosonic background equations
verify gravitino/chiralino mixing, local-SUSY constraints, boundary conditions, and a positive regular domain
show that the selected flavor-frame connection survives with no singular Einstein coefficient
claims.planned_scope: The executable checks only the spectator holomorphic Hessian of an Eto-Sakai-type matter-coupled candidate on the one-active-real-scalar, Z=0 slice and whether that holomorphic Hessian receives a common identity shift. It does not check the physical SUGRA fermion mass, a compensator/off-shell action, or physical eigenframe transport. The warped background, gravitino/chiralino system, boundary domain, positivity, and full local constraints remain unchecked.

falsification_and_failure: a Phase 11 strong representative cannot be removed without changing the bulk constraint
weak dilation removal requires more than a lapse rescaling and endpoint transformation
the selected mass matrix is not symmetric or the component transport angles differ
the rigid quadratic factorization or selected endpoint flavor identity fails under matched multiplet transport
the proposed anchored contraction changes under independent endpoint basis transformations
the calculation silently identifies the bosonic H_Sigma generator with a supercharge
non_goals: prove that supersymmetry is literally pre-Big-Bang time
put only bosons on one temporal branch and only fermions on the other
construct or cross a rank-changing Lorentzian tetrad
prove a static spatial BPS wall is a unitary spacelike temporal seam
derive kappa=pi/2 uniquely from minimal supergravity
prove a protected non-Abelian zero-mode bundle, anomaly-free quantum BFV closure, or a cosmological observable
identify the reduced anchored frame component with a full 4D propagator, scattering amplitude, or conversion probability
claim that the formal h_plus/minus bulk spurions construct a localized supersymmetric endpoint detector
claim self-adjointness, spectral positivity, or a full Weyl-fermion reduction without domains and boundary conditions
ratify a scientific verdict, programme appraisal, Contract status, or canon change

post_run_scope_amendments.reason: Independent adversarial audits required narrower language for the formal source selectors, differential adjoint, unexecuted Weyl reduction, and partial SUGRA Hessian check.
post_run_scope_amendments.effect_on_gates: No algebraic acceptance threshold or observed pass/fail result changed; all claims remain POST_HOC.
